description.value:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade explodes into a cloud of glitter. All creatures in the @Template[burst|distance:40] must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class] save. While the glitter is merely an annoyance for most, it interferes with creatures that are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Invisible] (or that later become invisible). The glitter lasts for 1 hour.

Critical Success The creature avoids the glitter entirely.

Success The creature avoids most of the glitter and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed] instead of invisible.

Failure The creature is covered in glitter and can be targeted with no flat check due to being invisible.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Dazzled] for 1 minute as the glitter gets in their eyes, though they can end the dazzled condition with an Interact action.
